title: 10-story steel moment frame
purpose: A 100 x 75 ft steel moment frame, W14x90 columns (the end columns turned 90 degrees) and W24x76 beams, ten 13 ft stories, rigid floors. An equivalent-lateral-force pattern and a design-shaped spectrum combined by CQC; mass from joint masses.

settings.mass: 900 kip per floor as joint masses
settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.sections: AISC W14x90 and W24x76 as general sections (table A, I, J)
settings.spectrum: 0.4 g to a 1.0 g plateau (0.2-0.6 s), then 0.6/T g; CQC, 5%
